because: Counterexample (hunt round 4, 2026-10-12): --storm-threshold=-0.1 made 0 of 3 attacked nodes a DistributedStorm and the latch kept strict mode on for good (ADR-0006); 50 or NaN silently disabled storm defense.
statement: The storm threshold is a share of live nodes, finite and in [0, 1); any other value is refused at startup, so a cluster with no attacked node is never a distributed storm.
